sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx microbolometer, 400x300, 17 um pixel pitch, 7-14 um, NETD <40 mK; optical: 1/1.9in Sony CMOS 2MP (1944x1092)
features: bi-spectrum thermal + visible positioning system (400x300 thermal + 2MP 30x visible)
long-range thermal lens 25/35/60/100 mm (athermalized, focus-free); visible 30x optical zoom (6-180 mm)
pan 0 to 360 endless, tilt -90 to +40, 300 presets, pan speed up to 160 deg/s
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C (low), 0 to 550 C (high), accuracy Max (+/-2 C, +/-2%)
release_notes: Ultra-series long-range thermal positioning system pairing a 400x300 uncooled VOx thermal channel (up to 100 mm lens) with a 2MP 30x-zoom visible channel; supports temperature measurement to 550 C and fire detection on a 24 VAC platform.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels; PTZ via ONVIF.
